name: Surface-Aware Splat Graph Construction
definition: A graph construction method that establishes connectivity exclusively along the surface manifold by defining connectivity as an intersection of Gaussian kernels, filtering out spurious neighbors that are close in Euclidean space but distant along the surface.
summary: Surface-Aware Splat Graph Construction defines Gaussian kernel adjacency via occupancy region intersections, ensuring topologically correct connectivity along the surface manifold rather than Euclidean proximity.
